task_message:
Case V51: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 96x96x58 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete.

**Summary of segmentation:**
- **Target:** A lobulated, markedly hyperintense (T2, fat-suppressed) soft-tissue mass — consistent with a vascular soft-tissue tumor (e.g., hemangioma) — located in the anterolateral soft tissues of the limb.
- **Approach:** Located the lesion with axial/coronal/sagittal contact sheets, seeded it with two positive points on its largest cross-section, refined the boundary with the model, then verified coverage slice-by-slice at the upper pole (k≈14–18), mid-portion (k≈25–28), and lower pole (k≈38–44), plus the coronal and sagittal extents.
- **Correction:** A second, separately prompted hyperintense ring/vessel-like structure (donut-shaped on axial, lying ~1–2 cm medial to the mass) was examined and judged non-tumoral (vessel/cyst-like), so its component was removed, leaving a single-component mask.
- **Result:** 10.8 mL, one component, extent axial 14–43, coronal 31–61, sagittal 43–74; the final review (five slices per plane, including just past each end) showed an outline that follows the lesion boundary with no stray components and no residual lesion in the past-the-mask panels.
